text:
elaine: FYI onboarding sampleapp showing weird behavior — after an auth retry, logs sometimes have two different reqids for the same logical request and PII didn't get redacted in one of them. Repro steps below.

marco: ugh. do you have the log snippet + sdk init?

elaine: here — minimal log lines (sanitized):\n```\nINFO 2026-03-23 request_id=abc123 user_email=alice@example.com action=login\nWARN 2026-03-23 request_id=def456 user_email=alice@example.com action=login retry=1\n```\nfirst line redacted OK, second leaked the email. sdk init looks like:\n```\nTelemetry.init({ hooks: [otelHook, redactHook, samplerHook] })\n```\nI suspect otelHook is being registered/triggered twice because our retry middleware re-emits the span/context.

jen: does this happen in node + python or just one runtime?

elaine: repro'd in node sampleapp (express + sdk v0.12.3) only so far.

sam: likely hook ordering + sampler race. If sampler runs before redact and retry creates a new trace context, the second emission might skip redaction. two quick options: move redactHook to run at emit time, or make redact idempotent and run earlier.

marco: can we make the redact hook run on emit instead of attach? i.e., operate on the final log record rather than on span start.

elaine: quick local patch I tried — seems to fix the leak:\n```\n// pseudo\nlogEmitter.on('record', (rec) => {\n  if (!rec.__redacted) { redact(rec); rec.__redacted = true }\n});\n```\nworks locally, avoids double-redact by marking. still need to be careful about perf.

devex-bot: created issue DE-5134 for "double otel hook causing reqid mismatch & redaction miss" — https://jira/redwood/DE-5134 :eyes:

sam: also add an integration test for the retry path where middleware re-emits with a new reqid. i can pair on that.

jen: did we check mobile/sampleapp native shims? iirc mobile uses a different hook ordering.

marco: mobile not affected — native shim registers hooks differently. this is a node-only expressive middleware issue when we re-dispatch the request.

elaine: proposed plan: 1) add test covering retry path + middleware re-emit; 2) change redactHook to operate on final emit by default; 3) mark records as redacted to avoid repeated work; 4) ship 0.12.4-canary with patch and monitor telemetry dashboards for tokenized email leaks.

sam: sg. i'll pick up the test tomorrow and pair on the change. +cc @oncall for visibility.

marco: note for changelog: "fix: ensure request IDs stable across retries and redact PII on final log emit (node SDK)".

elaine: :thumbsup: thanks team, will add the repro and the small patch to DE-5134 and assign.
